card_reads.read: Our top-rated horse in a $20,000 optional claimer. Three of them want the lead. The barn's angle in this exact spot is among the best in the field. The edge is real but sits under our bet line at 4 points. We make the favourite, #8 MURSAL, 20% against the board's 26%, shorter than we think it should be. Our own top-rated is #6 PINK ROSE. We are not betting the race; take it as an opinion, not a play.
card_reads.shape: Three of the 8 are entitled to the early lead, so the early fractions over a mile on dirt in a $20,000 optional claimer should be contested rather than soft. Our pace adjustment credits #6 Pink Rose and #7 Baby Sassicaia on that basis.
